ofb/ofboot0_barracks.name: Santego Military Base: Barracks
ofb/ofboot0_barracks.description: A long barracks of steel bunks and footlockers at Santego Military Base, Arizona. Your drill instructor is standing very close to you and shouting.

ofb/ofboot1_course.name: Obstacle Course
ofb/ofboot1_course.description: An obstacle course of walls, crawl nets, ladders and a muddy rope swing. A corporal times you with a stopwatch and an expression of contempt.

ofb/ofboot2_climb.name: Climbing and Rappelling Tower
ofb/ofboot2_climb.description: A wooden tower with ropes, ladders and a zip line. The instructor says you'll be dropping into worse than this.

ofb/ofboot3_range.name: Firing Range
ofb/ofboot3_range.description: A firing range of pop-up targets and sandbags. A rack holds a 9mm and a pipe wrench for the melee drills.

ofb/ofboot4_grenades.name: Grenade Pit and Medical Drill
ofb/ofboot4_grenades.description: A grenade pit behind a concrete wall, and a medical tent where a corpsman teaches you which end of a syringe to hold. Your graduation is waiting at the end.
